name: Paracetamol
precautions: Use only according to the product label or advice from a healthcare professional. Avoid taking multiple products that contain the same active ingredient.
whenToSeekHelp: Seek professional advice if symptoms are severe, persistent, or getting worse.

name: Cetirizine
precautions: It may cause drowsiness in some people. Follow the product label or professional advice.
whenToSeekHelp: Seek urgent medical help for serious allergic reactions or difficulty breathing.

name: Metformin
precautions: Use under the supervision of a healthcare professional. Do not start or stop diabetes medication without professional advice.
whenToSeekHelp: Contact a healthcare professional if you experience concerning or unusual symptoms.

name: Amlodipine
precautions: Use exactly as directed by a healthcare professional. Regular blood-pressure monitoring may be recommended.
whenToSeekHelp: Seek professional advice for severe or unusual symptoms.

name: Losartan
precautions: Use under professional guidance, particularly if you have kidney problems or take other medicines.
whenToSeekHelp: Contact a healthcare professional if you develop concerning symptoms.

name: Sumatriptan
precautions: Use only according to professional advice and the product information.
whenToSeekHelp: Seek urgent medical attention for severe chest symptoms or symptoms that are unusual for you.

name: Ibuprofen
precautions: Some people should avoid or use caution with this type of medicine. Follow the product label or ask a healthcare professional.
whenToSeekHelp: Seek professional advice for severe symptoms or signs of an adverse reaction.

name: Omeprazole
precautions: Use according to the product information or professional advice, especially if symptoms continue.
whenToSeekHelp: Seek professional advice if symptoms persist, become severe, or are associated with warning signs.
